known_residuals: dim3 (call-tree to implementation leaf) is NOT uniformly closed across all 16 macOS commands: bring_main_window_forward, bring_main_window_force_forward, apply_native_hotspot_properties, set_window_alpha, create_hotspot_window (main-thread branch), compute_hotspot_frame, has_notch_screen all terminate directly at real AppKit/Cocoa leaf calls (NSApplication.setActivationPolicy/activateIgnoringOtherApps, NSRunningApplication.activateWithOptions, NSWindow.setAlphaValue/setLevel/setCollectionBehavior/setHasShadow/setOpaque/setBackgroundColor/setFrame_display/orderFrontRegardless, NSScreen.auxiliaryTopLeftArea/auxiliaryTopRightArea/frame). However focus_main_window, reveal_main_window, force_reveal_main_window, refresh_hotspot_on_main, register_hotspot_relayout_observers, and create_hotspot_window's off-main-thread branch all terminate at `tauri_runtime_wry::send_user_message` dispatching a boxed Rust closure to the main thread via an anonymous compiler-generated symbol (e.g. `anon_0df76e0cec988e6dc281ac0519b88803_1168`) -- the closure BODY itself is not present as a separately named/decompiled .c file in raw/aimami/1.2.3/macos-arm64/commands/hotspot/ida/pseudocode/, so the exact native call the closure makes once it reaches the main thread is inferred from context (boolean flag argument differentiating focus/reveal variants, msg-tag constants observed in bring_main_window_forward's 4 direct send_user_message calls: 39/40/57/58) but not independently confirmed by reading the closure's own decompiled body.

install_native_hotspot_observers registers 5 real NSNotificationCenter observers (NSApplicationDidChangeScreenParametersNotification, NSWorkspaceDidWakeNotification, NSWorkspaceScreensDidWakeNotification, NSWorkspaceSessionDidBecomeActiveNotification, NSWorkspaceActiveSpaceDidChangeNotification) but each handler is also an anonymous Block2/Rust-closure trampoline (`anon_4fd0d0f33f5bcd90fdaba20400e954f2_466`) whose body is not separately decompiled -- plausibly (by call-site position and the RELAYOUT_VERSION debounce pattern seen in schedule_hotspot_relayout) it calls schedule_hotspot_relayout, but this is inference, not confirmed by reading the handler body itself.
